item.title: Celebration of Life: Carl Amato
item.description: Carl Amato, 67, passed away peacefully, leaving behind a legacy of love, laughter and quiet generosity. Born in New York, Carl held great pride that he went from Boy Scouts to Eagle Scouts. Carl made his way west and eventually settled here in Tehachapi in 1990, where he built a life rooted in kindness, humor and devotion to family and animals. item.title: Understanding the 2025 Petition for Succession to Real Property in California
item.description: In California, navigating the probate process after a loved one's death can be complex and time-consuming. However, for smaller estates involving real property, the state offers a streamlined alternative known as the Petition to Determine Succession to Real Property. item.title: Tehachapi First Baptist Church welcomes new Pastor
item.description: On Jan. 4 the Membership of the Tehachapi First Baptist Church enthusiastically voted for Pastor Marcus Lewis of Los Osos. Pastor Lewis will replace retiring Pastor John Lopez who, with his wife Nita, served 8 productive years at First Baptist Church. item.title: Meet Your New Neighbors
item.description: Eric Dyer moved to Tehachapi in March of 2025 from Bakersfield where he had lived for 34 years. He was hired this year as the new music teacher for Jacobsen Middle School where he is teaching both band and choir. item.description: We were able to continue the tradition of taking photos with Santa again this year. item.title: Wandering Downtown with Tehachapi Walks
item.description: Tehachapi Walks, where citizens and city officials take a stroll downtown side-by-side, has returned for 2026. The event originated in 2024 as a collaboration with the Tehachapi Valley Recreation & Parks District, then later evolved into different programs, but demand has led to the resurrection of the original walk.
